values.note: FAS camping $12/night with a valid fishing license, $18 without (the split is by fishing license, not residency). FWP's 2026 fee table gives $5 / $7.50 for MT residents 62+, disabled or veterans. The page also lists conservation licenses (MT resident $8, senior/youth $4, nonresident $10).

fees.source: https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39754103 (Facilities & Fees: 'FAS Camping Without Valid Fishing License 18.0', 'FAS Camping With Valid Fishing License 12.0') + https://fwp.mt.gov/binaries/content/assets/fwp/fish/fas/2026-fas-fee-table_adopted.pdf (as previously recorded), read 2026-10-22

sites.source: https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39754103 (Restrictions: 'Vehicle Length Trailer Length is 25ft.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: FWP lists a toilet (type not stated), primitive campsites and a gravel boat ramp; no drinking water listed. Accessibility rated 'Difficult'.

facilities.source: https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39754103 (Facilities: 'Toilet', 'Primitive Campsite', 'Ramp (Gravel)'; ADA Accessibility 'Difficult Accessibility'), read 2026-10-22

note: Montana FWP fishing access site (151 acres, ~4,140 ft) on Upsata Lake with designated primitive camping (Region 2). Directions (FWP): 37 miles east of Bonner on Hwy 200 to milepost 38, then 4 miles north on Woodworth Road. --Claude
summary: FWP FishMT page: confirmed $12/$18 FAS camping, 25-ft trailer length, 7-day stay limit, toilet, primitive campsites and gravel ramp.
